cohort: Women in Victoria, Australia, over a 10-year period who attempted a VBAC with a term singleton live birth (n=22,062)
finding: Two VBAC prediction models, one for use during labor and one for antenatal use, demonstrated adequate performance in predicting successful VBAC in an Australian cohort.
mod_finding: This study developed a model to predict the likelihood of successful vaginal birth after cesarean (VBAC).
